english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a three-dimensional statue or sculptural work.
Use 雕像 for an individual sculpted artwork, especially one representing a person, animal, or figure.

examples.english: This statue is carved to look just like a real person.
examples.traditional: 呢座雕像雕得好似真人咁。
